courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 運輸機氣動外形風洞驗證
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 機體尺度、載荷條件、材料方向及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Aircraft scale, load conditions, material direction and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課的工程脈絡由「量測組態與指標版本身份」推進到「事件時間積分與SEL教學」，最後以「指標適用邊界與證據交接」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
courses.summaryEn: The engineering progression moves from Measurement configuration and metric version through Event integration and illustrative SEL to Metric applicability and evidence handoff. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

history.title: 民航機噪音認證概念
history.text: 本課的工程脈絡由「量測組態與指標版本身份」推進到「事件時間積分與SEL教學」，最後以「指標適用邊界與證據交接」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
history.textEn: The engineering progression moves from Measurement configuration and metric version through Event integration and illustrative SEL to Metric applicability and evidence handoff. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

courses.connection: 以「區分聲學量測、事件指標和法規符合性證據」為主線，在民航噪音合成事件與證據檢查台中依序完成量測組態與指標版本身份、背景能量與事件分離、事件時間積分與SEL教學、音調頻譜與時間窗、事件抽樣及天候代表性及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
courses.connectionEn: Follow Distinguish acoustic measurement, event metrics and regulatory evidence in a Synthetic civil-aircraft noise events and evidence bench, progressing through Measurement configuration and metric version, Separating background energy and events, Event integration and illustrative SEL, Tonal spectra and time windows, Event sampling and weather representativeness, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
